title: Trip distribution
caption: The original heatmap contains 21 effective OD-zone indices, using the sorted union of origin and destination IDs. Colors show log(1 + person trips) for 08:00–09:00 HBW. The zone-index table preserves all 21 modeled zones; absent OD cells remain zero, and unassigned intrazonal and unreachable movements are not imputed. Single-pass engineering scenario; no local empirical calibration.
